tapeLine: US stocks fell Wednesday: the S&P 500 slipped 0.22% to 7,801.77, the Nasdaq Composite 0.22% to 27,538.69 and the Dow 341.41 points (0.66%) to 51,179.87, retreating from Tuesday's records, per CNBC. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to as high as 5.350% Wednesday, topping Monday's high; it was 5.326% intraday, per CNBC via Yahoo Finance. No Thursday-morning futures or yield levels were found.
